column1: # compat/notes.tsv: hand-written status and notes for the compatibility page, by No-Intro name. Tab-separated:

column1: Legend of Zelda, The - Ocarina of Time - Master Quest (USA) (GameCube)
column3: Runs (Retroid Pocket Flip, 2026-11-12). The earlier close on the Odin 3 Portal was a fault in the test setup, not the game.

Hung before its first frame until 2026-11-12: this Wii Virtual Console copy kept the cartridge's header checksum over changed code, so the boot code never finished. Since core rel2 c994aa7 Joey64 boots it with the right checksum (checked on the Retroid Pocket Flip and Duo).
